column4: cleat#2870: eventtriggers' idempotency regression test for Version 10's MySQL DROP INDEX guard on idx_ingested_events_unprocessed, mirroring TestV1V3IndexesAreIdempotentOnMySQL's existing grant on this same line (test-go/plugins) for the same reason -- that job's env is CLEAT_TEST_DB/CLEAT_CRASH_DB only, postgres service, no mysql or mssql service, so this test skips once in this job while PostgreSQL-backed tests run. MySQL-only by nature, not by omission.
